grades.overall_note: The agent handled the safety points well: it chased the landlord in writing, gave the tenant an honest update with no works date, and spotted the contradictory approval note. However, it missed the landlord's own-contractor route via Oakley, framing the contractor as the agency's, gave the landlord no reply-by date, and its case notes are incomplete.
